rationale: Modest-profit round trips and post-peak rank-retention association are material, so no blanket no-problem finding.
Large earned-profit collapse is not typical: all15 >=30% episodes exit profitably,11 retain at least75%,3 retain below50%,1 below25%.
Top3 winners provide106.37% of full-account net profit, indicating substantial right-tail dependence.
Annual small samples and absent independent canonical development/validation split prevent a stable validation claim.
Under the requested genuinely-yes gate, present evidence does not justify opening an exit-research campaign; this does not prove exits cannot improve.
